sara: Heads-up — on the 70B canary with INT8-encoded KV I’m seeing a ~12% latency win and ~23% GPU mem reduction, but decode quality dropped on long-context evals (token error spike, weird repeats). repro suite (long-context-prompts) ppl up ~0.9 and some hallucination cases.

ben: Do you have kernel selection / trace logs? Could be an unexpected kernel fallback or a batching heuristic change.

sara: Pasting the top of the trace we captured (kernel routing + kv selection):
```
[2026-02-18T14:03:12Z] kv_store: INT8_ENC selected
[2026-02-18T14:03:12Z] kernel: attn_v1_int8 (fast-path)
[2026-02-18T14:03:12Z] kernel_switch: none
[2026-02-18T14:03:12Z] batch_size: 8 (auto-batched from 4 -> 8)
[2026-02-18T14:03:12Z] decode_error_rate: 0.052 (baseline fp8: 0.004)
```
This is from the canary node with default kernel thresholds. No explicit fallback triggered.

anjali: That decode_error_rate jump is large — suspiciously like a calibration mismatch between activation ranges and the per-layer INT8 scales. What calibration dataset / sample count did you use?

sara: We used global calibr with 512 samples (mixed prompts: code + docs). Also changed throughput knob so batching went to 8 for that workload.

ben: Two quick probes: 1) rerun with per-layer calibration (or per-channel) and 2) force kernel selection to prefer fp8 for KV (keep int8 for matmuls). Example repro command: `./tools/run_perf.py --model redwood-70b --kv-format int8 --batch 8 --calib global512 --trace /tmp/trace.json`. Also inspect `kernel_switch_thresholds` (config) — if thresholds are too aggressive we might be using an int8 kernel that loses small-value precision in KV leading to decode drift.

devin: My rough numbers from an internal run: int8-kv -> mem -25%, latency -11%, but decode-quality -5% (measured by token-error-rate on long-context eval). Hybrid (kv fp8 + core int8) gives -18% mem but quality close to fp8 baseline.

perf-bot: Canary run report: canary-1793012345 | int8-kv ON | latency -12% | gpu_mem -23% | decode-quality delta -6.2% | ppl delta +0.9 | trace: s3://redwood-perf/canaries/1793012345/trace.json

anjali: Proposal: create an A/B canary with 10% traffic using int8-kv but with an automated fallback policy: if token-error-rate > 0.02 (per 1k tokens) for 5 consecutive minutes, switch that shard to fp8-kv. Also run per-channel calibration and compare.

sara: Makes sense — I’ll spin the A/B canary and run per-channel calibrations. Plan: 1) repro with per-channel 2048 samples, 2) run hybrid (fp8 KV only) test, 3) add fallback policy and monitor token-error-rate metric. I’ll upload traces and the calibration artifacts to /mnt/kvcache/1793/ by EOD. Thanks all :raised_hands:

ben: Awesome. If you see kernel_switch events, ping me and I’ll help triage (might be an op-level bug where the int8 kernel zeroes small kv values).

sara: Will do — logging the thread here for visibility and next steps.
